en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a canal with a steamship moored beside a large Renaissance castle complex. Round stone bastions with domed roofs stand in the water, and a tall church-like tower rises from the main building behind trees. The foreground shows a grassy path and trees along the canal. Printed captions and a publisher's mark appear in the lower part of the image.
